# PerchTV 0.1.8

Films and episodes now skip, and the television keeps listening after the screensaver.

## WHAT CHANGED

- Skip on the remote: left (or ⏪) goes back 10 seconds, right (or ⏩) forward 30. Hold the key to keep going. A thin bar shows where you are and fades away on its own. Films and episodes only; live channels are unchanged.
- Fixed: after the screensaver, the Home button or switching inputs, the television said Paired but ignored everything the phone sent until the app was restarted. It now picks up where it left off.

## WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Pairing, casting from the phone, play/pause and stop, and 0.1.7's update check on every start.
